thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: SLA breach detected for tenant `lumenpay` — 5m error rate 7.8% (threshold 5%) across /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Auto-page sent to #eng-oncall.
Maria Chen: seeing it. hitting the dashboard now. looks like spikes every ~30s.
Devin Park: oof, yeah I can reproduce a stair-step of 429s then short recovery. Might be client retry storm.
Samir Patel: any deploys? I don't see recent model rollouts in the last hour.
Jules Rivera: no deploys from infra. Could be network flapping or a periodic check from LumenPay. Nora (cust-succ): paging from customer — they reported "slow responses" starting ~09:12.
Maria Chen: placing LumenPay on watchlist and opening a tenant-specific timeline.
oncall-bot: @Maria Chen added `lumenpay` to watchlist.
Devin Park: quick mitigation: can we mute the per-tenant heartbeat check that is firing noisy alerts? The check is adding to the SLA alarm aggregation.
Samir Patel: propose two steps: 1) temporary suppress tenant-level SLA alert to stop paging; 2) create a debounced composite that requires 3/5 consecutive windows before paging.
Jules Rivera: agree. also add a quick dashboard panel for request pattern by client_id, sequence + latency.
Maria Chen: I'm going to mute the current alert in PagerDuty and update the alert rule in Grafana. Doing PD mute now.
Maria Chen: PD: muted incident. note: still tracking in our internal dashboard, not silencing logs.
Devin Park: copying current alert rule for record:
```
ALERT lumenpay_sla_breach WHEN
  increase(tenant_error_rate{tenant="lumenpay"}[5m]) > 0.05
FOR 2m
ANNOTATIONS { severity="page" }
```
We should change FOR to 10m and require rate > 0.07 or add count-based debounce.
Samir Patel: alternative: keep FOR=5m but change to `FOR 3m` and add `unless increase(...) < 0.03` for transient spikes.
Jules Rivera: while you tweak rules, can someone query request pattern? I want to confirm it's a single client_id causing retries.
Devin Park: running query now: `topk(5, sum(rate(requests_total{tenant="lumenpay"}[1m])) by (client_id))`
Devin Park: output shows client_id=lp-service-2 ramping then dropping. Looks like an internal scheduled job in lumenpay hitting bursts.
Nora (cust-succ): confirmed with LumenPay — they rolled an internal data-sync at 09:10 that retries aggressively on 429. They're fixing client-side backoff.
Maria Chen: good to know. I'll push a conservative alert change: set threshold to 8% and require 3/5 windows. Updating Grafana alert now.
Maria Chen: new rule (applied):
```
ALERT lumenpay_sla_breach_v2 WHEN
  increase(tenant_error_rate{tenant="lumenpay"}[5m]) > 0.08
FOR 3m
ANNOTATIONS { severity="page" }
```
Samir Patel: also adding a composite check so that account-level SLA pages only if error rate sustained *and* 10% of requests originate from more than 1 client_id (to avoid single-client storms).
Jules Rivera: can we add a 10m rolling average widget on the infra console and pin to the oncall dashboard? helps future triage.
Maria Chen: adding dashboard panel and a log query: `json_extract(request_body, "$.trace_id")` to correlate failures.
Devin Park: temp mitigation: increase rate-limiter for lumenpay on edge to 200rps and add a short 5s jittered backoff header so their client gets 503 instead of overwhelming our inference pool.
Samir Patel: careful — changing rate limits has customer impact. Let's coordinate with Nora and LumenPay before we alter production limits.
Nora (cust-succ): LumenPay approves a temporary soft-throttle, they prefer 503+Retry-After over cascade retries.
Maria Chen: rolled soft-throttle via feature flag (edge-control) for tenant lumenpay -> applied.
oncall-bot: @Maria Chen toggled feature_flag lumenpay_edge_throttle -> true.
Devin Park: good. monitoring CPU/GPU queues now. queue length dropped 60% in two mins.
Jules Rivera: can someone drop a quick note in the tenant SLA doc and propose a permanent alert rewrite? I can capture the post-incident tasks.
Maria Chen: creating a ticket: TKT-4821 "LumenPay: noisy heartbeat & SLA alert rewrite" assigning to eng-sre, owner Jules.
Samir Patel: post-incident actions: 1) change alert to debounced composite (3 windows), 2) add client_id cardinality check, 3) doc recommended per-tenant rate-limits and backoff guidance, 4) add 10m rolling average dashboard, 5) follow up with LumenPay for client fix.
Jules Rivera: thanks. I'll run a quick retro in #eng-sre later today, include runbook update.
Maria Chen: ending handoff to next oncall in 15m. @Devin take after me?
Devin Park: happy to. I'll monitor for 30m then hand to weekday oncall.
Maria Chen: summary: muted noisy PD pages, applied soft-throttle with customer consent, updated alert to v2 (3m require + higher threshold), added dashboard panels and ticketed follow-ups.
Nora (cust-succ): LumenPay appreciates the quick coordination. They'll push the client backoff fix today. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Maria Chen: closing thread once we confirm 1h of stable metrics.
Devin Park: will reopen if noise resurfaces. :thumbsup:
